registered_use: Control of early blight (Alternaria solani) in tomato.
notes: FRAC Group M03 (Dithiocarbamate). Protectant contact fungicide with multi-site activity.
safety_notes: Blue triangle (Moderately Toxic). Waiting period (PHI): 3 days. Wear full PPE.

registered_use: Control of early blight in tomato.
notes: FRAC M03 + 11. Dual-action protectant and strobilurin translaminar fungicide.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Waiting period (PHI): 5 days. Do not exceed 3 applications per season.

registered_use: Systemic control of early blight in tomato.
notes: FRAC Group 3 (Triazole DMI). Systemic curative and protective action.
safety_notes: Yellow triangle (Highly Toxic). Waiting period (PHI): 5 days.

registered_use: Contact control of early blight in tomato.
notes: FRAC Group M01 (Inorganic Copper). Broad spectrum multi-site protectant.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Do not tank-mix with highly acidic inputs. Waiting period: 3 days.

registered_use: Canopy ventilation, pruning lower infected foliage, and avoiding sprinkler splash.
notes: Mulching with black polythene or organic straw reduces splash dispersal of Alternaria spores from soil.

registered_use: Bio-antagonist seed treatment and root zone drenching against fungal pathogens.
notes: Fungal biocontrol agent that parasitizes pathogenic hyphae and induces systemic resistance.
safety_notes: Green triangle (Bio-pesticide). Non-hazardous to mammals and pollinators.

registered_use: Control of late blight in tomato.
notes: FRAC Group 27 + M03. Combines penetrant local curative action with protectant.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Waiting period: 5 days. Spray immediately upon blight forecast.

registered_use: Oomycete cell wall synthesis inhibitor for late blight control.
notes: FRAC Group 40 (CAA fungicide). Highly active against sporangia and oospores.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Waiting period: 5 days. Must be tank mixed or rotated with protectant.

registered_use: Proactive monitoring during overcast high-humidity periods and elimination of cull piles.
notes: Avoid flood irrigation in poorly drained soil. Remove and deep-bury heavily blighted foliage.
safety_notes: Cultural hygiene prevents epidemic spread across neighboring plots.

registered_use: Bacteriostatic control of bacterial spot and canker in tomato.
notes: FRAC Group M01. Copper ions disrupt bacterial enzyme systems.

registered_use: Antibiotic formulation for bacterial disease suppression.
notes: Use strictly according to registered label claims to prevent antimicrobial resistance.
safety_notes: Prescription use only. Wear face protection and protective apparel.

registered_use: Lipid biosynthesis inhibitor for red spider mite control on tomato.
notes: IRAC Group 23 (Tetronic acid derivatives). Active against mite nymphal and egg stages.

registered_use: Contact acaricide and fungicide for mite suppression on tomato.
notes: Inorganic protectant with multi-site contact action against phytophagous mites.
safety_notes: Green triangle. Do not spray when temperature exceeds 35°C (risk of phytotoxicity).

registered_use: Yellow sticky trap installation for whitefly vector monitoring and population reduction.
notes: TYLCV is vectored by Bemisia tabaci. Traps provide early warning before viral transmission.
safety_notes: Zero chemical residues. Safe for beneficials.

registered_use: Vector control of whitefly transmitting TYLCV.
notes: Targeted at insect vector; no chemical viricide can eliminate virus once plant is infected.

registered_use: Strict tool sanitation and elimination of infected seedlings.
notes: ToMV is mechanically transmitted through sap, hands, tools, and tobacco products. Chemical sprays are completely ineffective against established virus.
safety_notes: Workers must wash hands with soap before touching transplants.

registered_use: Protective contact fungicide against Septoria and leaf spot complexes.
notes: FRAC Group M05. Non-systemic broad-spectrum foliar protectant.
safety_notes: Yellow triangle. Wear goggles and face mask. Toxic to aquatic organisms.

registered_use: Foliar spray for leaf mold management in polyhouse and field tomatoes.
notes: Ensure thorough coverage of lower leaf surfaces where velvety fungal sporulation occurs.

registered_use: Control of target spot and foliar blight in tomato.
notes: FRAC Group 11 (QoI Strobilurin). Do not apply more than two sequential applications without rotating.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Waiting period: 3 days. Toxic to fish.

registered_use: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) for healthy tomato maintenance.
notes: Routine weekly scouting; monitor bottom leaves for early symptom appearance.

registered_use: Protective spray against apple scab.
notes: FRAC Group M03. Fundamental protective base for scab management program.

registered_use: Curative and protective systemic control of apple scab.
notes: FRAC Group 3. Post-infection curative action up to 72 hours from start of infection.
safety_notes: Yellow triangle. Waiting period: 14 days. Limit to 2 sprays per season.

registered_use: Specific protectant and kickback fungicide for apple scab.
notes: FRAC Group U12. Highly specific to Venturia inaequalis.

registered_use: Protective foliar fungicide for apple scab prevention.
notes: FRAC Group M04 (Phthalimide). Excellent fruit finish; multi-site protectant.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Do not combine with oil sprays (risk of severe foliage burn).

registered_use: Orchard floor sanitation and post-harvest 5% urea spray on fallen leaves.
notes: Accelerates microbial decomposition of fallen leaves, eliminating up to 80% of overwintering ascospores.
safety_notes: Safe agronomic practice. Enhances soil nitrogen mineralization.

registered_use: Control of black rot and canker in apple trees.
notes: FRAC Group 1 (Benzimidazole). Apply to pruning cuts and cankers.

registered_use: Protective spray against rust in pome fruit.
notes: Protectant cover spray prevents aeciospore germination on young leaves.

registered_use: Orchard tree canopy training, balanced pruning, and regular scouting.
notes: Maintain open canopy to ensure rapid leaf drying after precipitation.

registered_use: Control of early blight in potato.
notes: FRAC Group M03. Contact protectant.

registered_use: Control of late blight in potato.
notes: FRAC Group 27 + M03. Provides curative kickback within 48 hours of infection.

registered_use: Systemic and contact control of late blight in potato.
notes: FRAC Group 4 + M03. Acropetal systemic translaminar translocation.

registered_use: High earthing up and haulm cutting to protect tubers from blight infection.
notes: Prevents motile zoospores from washing down through soil cracks onto developing tubers.
safety_notes: Zero chemical residue. Drastically lowers post-harvest rot.

registered_use: Healthy crop maintenance and disease monitoring.
notes: Routine scouting. No symptoms detected.

registered_use: Control of rust and foliar blights in maize.
notes: FRAC Group M03. Contact multi-site protectant.

registered_use: Broad-spectrum systemic control of rust and turcicum blight in maize.
notes: FRAC Group 11 + 3. Provides preventive and curative systemic protection.

registered_use: Early planting and balanced nitrogen management.
notes: Excessive succulent nitrogenous growth significantly aggravates rust pustule severity.

registered_use: Control of Turcicum / Northern leaf blight in maize.
notes: FRAC Group M03. Contact protectant.

condition: Cercospora Leaf Spot Gray Leaf Spot
registered_use: Control of foliar leaf spots in maize.
notes: FRAC Group 11 + 3. Apply when lesions appear on lower leaves before reaching ear leaf.

registered_use: Healthy maize maintenance and scout monitoring.
notes: Foliage is green and unblemished. Continue routine field inspection.

registered_use: Protective spray against anthracnose, black rot, and downy mildew in grapes.
notes: FRAC Group M03. Fundamental protective base for grapevine spray calendar.

registered_use: Control of anthracnose and fungal berry rots in grapevine.
notes: FRAC Group 1. Use sparingly to avoid resistant biotypes.

registered_use: Pruning wound sealing and removal of infected trunk cordons.
notes: Esca is caused by complex vascular basidiomycetes and ascomycetes inside trunk heartwood. No curative foliar spray can eradicate internal trunk decay.
safety_notes: Sanitation prevents spore entry into xylem vessels.

registered_use: Foliar protectant against leaf blights in grapevine.
notes: FRAC Group M01. Apply after post-monsoon pruning.

registered_use: Canopy microclimate management and shoot positioning.
notes: Healthy foliage. Avoid unneeded chemical interventions.

registered_use: Control of bacterial leaf spot in bell pepper and chilli.
notes: FRAC Group M01. Apply preventively when weather is humid and warm.

registered_use: Hot water seed treatment and drip irrigation.
notes: Eradicates bacterial cells lodging beneath the seed coat without impairing germination.

registered_use: Balanced crop nutrition and scouting for thrips and mites.
notes: No disease symptoms present. Maintain IPM vigilance.

registered_use: Dormant and early season protective spray for bacterial spot in stone fruits.
notes: FRAC Group M01. Apply during dormant stage. Avoid copper during warm humid vegetative stages (stone fruit leaves are sensitive to copper phytotoxicity).
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Do not spray during bloom.

registered_use: Orchard hygiene and winter dormant pruning.
notes: Foliage healthy and free from bacterial shot-holes.

registered_use: Contact control of powdery mildew in temperate stone fruits.
notes: FRAC Group M02. Multi-site contact protectant.
safety_notes: Green triangle. Do not spray during intense heat.

registered_use: Temperate orchard monitoring and canopy pruning.
notes: Leaves clean. Continue standard seasonal tree care.

registered_use: Control of powdery mildew in cucurbit crops.
notes: FRAC Group M02. Contact protectant.

registered_use: Contact control of leaf spot and leaf scorch in strawberry.
notes: FRAC Group M01. Apply preventively before fruit set.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Do not spray during flowering.

registered_use: Drip irrigation and straw mulching maintenance.
notes: Foliage healthy and vigorous.

registered_use: Systemic control of Asian citrus psyllid (Diaphorina citri), vector of citrus greening.
notes: Targeted strictly at insect vector. Citrus greening (Candidatus Liberibacter) has no cure; systemic bactericides cannot cure infected trees.
safety_notes: Yellow triangle (Highly Toxic). High risk to honeybees; NEVER spray during bloom.

registered_use: Immediate rogueing and destruction of HLB-positive trees to prevent orchard epidemic.
notes: HLB causes irreversible phloem blockage and root collapse. Infected trees remain permanent inoculum sources.

registered_use: Routine soil pH monitoring and balanced irrigation.
notes: Canopy is healthy. Maintain acidic soil range (pH 4.5-5.5).

registered_use: Cane trellising and weed management.
notes: Healthy foliage. No disease symptoms present.

registered_use: Routine scouting for defoliators and rust.
notes: Canopy healthy and uninfected.

registered_use: Ryanodine receptor modulator for bollworm complex control in cotton.
notes: IRAC Group 28 (Diamides). Ovi-larvicidal and larvicidal action. Extremely selective.
safety_notes: Green triangle (Low mammalian toxicity). Waiting period: 9 days.

registered_use: Control of bollworms in cotton.
notes: IRAC Group 6 (Avermectins). Chloride channel activator causing rapid paralysis.
safety_notes: Blue triangle. Waiting period: 10 days. Toxic to honeybees during direct contact.

registered_use: Pheromone trap monitoring for Helicoverpa armigera and Pectinophora gossypiella.
notes: Economic Threshold Level (ETL): 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive days or 1 larva/plant.
safety_notes: Target-specific, species-pure pheromone lure. Non-toxic to all non-target fauna.

registered_use: Biological egg parasitism of Helicoverpa armigera.
notes: Parasitoid wasps destroy pest eggs before larvae hatch and penetrate cotton bolls.
safety_notes: 100% ecological. Do not spray broad-spectrum insecticides within 7 days of release.
